card.name: Start of ophthalmic and other split words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word that is split mid-word, most often the "o" starting "ophthalmic" or "ophthalmologic" after "prompt" or "not for". It also fires on pieces of names and other odd strings.

modes.label: ophthalmic split
modes.description: The "o" that begins ophthalmic or ophthalmologic after "prompt" or "not for" in label warnings.
modes.example: If visual disturbance occurs during treatment, prompt<< o>>phthalmologic evaluation is warranted.

modes.label: Other split names and strings
modes.description: Pieces of place names, surnames, drug names or numbers that sit partway through a word.

card.writes: It slightly favors line breaks and ellipsis-plus-newline endings and discourages long runs of blank lines.
card.plain: It fires on the opening letter of a long word, especially ophthalmic, that has been cut into pieces.
